chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 266: Puppet Logistics & the Great Derivative Art
chapter_meta_description: Han Li masters the Soul Tethering Technique and begins crafting Grade Two puppets. A deep dive into the real costs and limits of puppetry in the Mortal Stream.
og_description: Han Li extracts lizard souls and builds his puppet army, laying the groundwork for a new combat doctrine.
twitter_description: Han Li masters the Soul Tethering Technique for his puppet army. Pure Mortal Stream logistics.

lore_anchors.definition: A demonic-path spell for extracting a soul from a recently deceased body; it has a low success rate for early Foundation Establishment cultivators.
The foundational mental cultivation technique of the Thousand Bamboo Sect; it strengthens the primordial spirit and enables the Soul Divide technique for controlling multiple puppets.
A comprehensive manual covering the methods to refine puppets and mechanical beasts of every grade.
A method for combining multiple weak souls into a single, stronger artificial soul for higher-grade puppets.
A technique for processing and altering a soul so it can be fused into a puppet.
The condensed spiritual essence of a cultivator; the Great Derivative Art works by gradually strengthening this core.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li collecting animal souls?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Puppet Daoist Canon requires souls from living creatures to be fused into mechanical puppets to give them spiritual nature; without a soul, the puppet is just a doll.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the main flaw of the Great Derivative Art puppets?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They have a 3-li range limit and a delay between receiving a command and acting, which could be exploited in combat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li care about the Great Derivative Art so much?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Unlike common spirit-division arts, it actively strengthens the primordial spirit, allowing for more and finer splits of consciousness, which is essential for commanding a team of puppets.
